decisions.proposed_text: Có thể nhận bằng cách xem Cuộc đua thứ 11, là Cuộc đua chính của mỗi Nhóm A và B
decisions.reason: The same Heroes UI family renders 集团 as Nhóm; Bảng is inconsistent here. Preserve race number 11 and both generic race occurrences.
The win condition and post-event special-site publication meaning are faithful, with generic race terminology satisfied.
The Main Stage timing, 12:00 daily grant, quantities 5 and 10, bullet/newline structure and overflow behavior are preserved.
The Hero Gauge cycle, MAX trigger, counts 3/1/0, multi-line bullet structure, Hero Skill and Mã Nương terminology are preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: event.loh.hero_gauge = Hero Gauge; event.loh.hero_skill = Hero Skill; common.skill.generic = Skill; common.world.umamusume = Mã Nương; race.generic = Cuộc đua.

decisions.reason: The 1-set/5-race limitation, Mood/weather/gate conditions and corresponding race-item meaning are preserved with all embedded canonical terms satisfied.
decisions.terminology_basis: event.loh.hero_skill = Hero Skill; common.skill.generic = Skill; common.state.mood = Mood; source bridge state.mood = Mood; race.generic = Cuộc đua.
